title: Weakened CellComplex axioms: hypergraphs and non-pure complexes (axioms audit of SpernerMathlib.lean)

problemStatement.formal: \text{Identify the minimal axiomatic surface on which the door-counting parity argument in }\texttt{SpernerMathlib.lean}\text{ goes through, and ship a hypergraph-generalised variant }\texttt{SpernerMathlibHyper.lean}\text{ replacing the fixed index type }\mathrm{Fin}(d+1)\text{ with a cell-dependent }\iota: \mathrm{Cell}\to\mathrm{Type}^*.
problemStatement.plain: Audit the abstract cell-complex axioms in proofs/Proofs/SpernerMathlib.lean (897 lines, 0 sorries) and identify the minimal hypotheses on `vertex` and `adj` that support the door-counting parity argument. Two generalisations are proposed: (A) hypergraph — replace the uniform `Fin (d+1)` face index with a cell-dependent index type `ι s`; (B) non-pure complex — allow cells of varying dimensions. S1 OBSERVE locks the formal scope for both, supplies a Lean skeleton for the hypergraph version (~120 LOC, 0–1 sorries), and conjectures that non-pure generalisation reduces to the pure case via restriction.
whyMatters: Reusability: Sperner.even_card_fpf_invol is already abstracted for Tucker / Borsuk-Ulam; OQ-01 lifts the same reusability to the door-counting pipeline.
Hypergraph Sperner enables future formalisations of colorful KKM-type theorems and Kalai's conjecture variants.
The file is named SpernerMathlib.lean — a clean axiomatic surface is a prerequisite for upstream Mathlib review.

open: OQ-01-A (hypergraph): replace Fin (d+1) with ι : Cell → Type*; conjecture proof goes through with ~120 LOC mechanical adaptation.
OQ-01-B (non-pure): mixed-dimension cells break the parity statement at the type level; salvage via restriction to the pure top-dimensional sub-complex — yields no new content.
OQ-01-C (boundary-axioms minimality): hadj_ne is load-bearing under hadj_symm + hadj_vertex alone because adj s k = some ⟨s, k⟩ (self-face-loop) is otherwise admitted.

insights: The current file deliberately uses hypotheses-as-parameters rather than a structure CellComplex — this design choice already pre-empts most of the hypergraph generalisation cost.
Replacing Fin (d+1) with ι : Cell → Type* requires also abstracting the coloring codomain to a palette P of fixed cardinality, so that 'panchromatic' has a dimension-independent meaning.
Sperner's parity fails ill-formedly on non-pure complexes — not because the parity statement is false, but because mixed-dimensional cells cannot share a common notion of 'doors'.
hadj_ne (adjacent cells distinct) is load-bearing because hadj_vertex + hadj_symm alone admit the self-face-loop corner adj s k = some ⟨s, k⟩.

Sibling sperner-simplicial-bridge-oq-01 (concrete simplicial bridge, PR #18234 merged 2026-05-12) is complementary, not competing: the hypergraph API here is abstract; the simplicial bridge there is concrete.

S1b OBSERVE (#18344): the proposed IsDoorHyper from knowledge.md § 4.1 lacked a top-color asymmetry needed for the parity argument. Fix: parameterise on a fixed top : P. This is structural — without it, the hypergraph parity claim is ill-typed.

S1e OBSERVE (#18411): introduces the h-iota-size : forall s, card (iota s) ≤ card P constraint. This is necessary for the per-cell door-parity step to make sense (a door has card (iota s) − 1 colors used; without h-iota-size, the count is unsigned). Refines knowledge.md § 4.1 adjacency abstraction.

S2c PREP (#18688) + S2d PREP (#18727): door_count_parity_hyper has a clean two-case architecture under h-iota-size. Case card-equality: Equiv-transport to the pure case via Fintype.card_eq.mp. Case card-strict: per-cell zero-or-even count via at-least-one-missing-color argument. S2d ships paste-ready Mathlib bearer chains for both cases.

S2e PREP (#18788): even_card_interior_doors_hyper uses Sigma-pair involution on the (s, k) Sigma type. New Sigma-bearers cited: Sigma.instFintype, Sigma.instDecidableEq (for the involution well-definedness).

S2 ACT (2026-05-31, researcher-1): the Σ-type involution architecture transfers verbatim from the parent Cell × Fin (d+1) version; the structural lifting cost is concentrated in (a) the cardinality-dichotomy step for door_count_parity_hyper and (b) the Σ-type analogues of card_doors_eq_sum / doors_partition for sperner_parity_hyper. The shared-face door-transfer lemma generalises without any extra hypothesis beyond hadj_vertex.

Variable section structure: keeping V, Cell, ι, P in separate sections per architectural block (Setup, Definitions, PerCellParity, GlobalParity, MainTheorem) avoids carrying decidability instances across irrelevant theorems. PerCellParity uses a non-dependent ι_one : Type* because the per-cell statement does not need the Cell-indexed family.
mathlibGaps: Mathlib.Combinatorics.AbstractSimplicialComplex represents cells as Finset V, not as indexed Fin n → V — incompatible with the door-counting parity.
Mathlib.AlgebraicTopology.SimplicialSet is category-theoretic and heavier than needed.
No Mathlib API for cell-dependent dependent-index face complexes.
